result.title: A Controlled Evaluation of Curvature Inspired Scalar Feature Scaling for Domain Generalization
result.summary: Domain-specific curvature is an appealing idea for domain generalization (DG), but curvature learning can denote substantially different computations. This paper evaluates one deliberately narrow implementation: the code calls it HyperDG, but it rescales Euclidean encoder features during training by learned positive scalars and uses an ordinary linear classifier on unscaled Euclidean features at inference. It does not implement a Lorentz or Poincaré representation, geodesic prediction, or a Sharpness-Aware Minimization inner loop. We audit the executed objective and evaluate six conditions on PACS, VLCS, Office Home, and TerraIncognita. The completed design contains 384 runs: six conditions, four held-out targets, and four run seeds per dataset. Checkpoints are selected using only the three source-validation environments. Inference first averages paired seed differences within each held-out target; targets, rather than 16 seed-by-target observations, are the per-dataset clusters. The full implementation's equal-dataset macro point estimate is 1.61 percentage points below native DomainBed ERM (95% clustered CI [-3.17, -0.04]). All four dataset point estimates favor ERM, but an exact four-dataset sign-flip test gives p = .125 and Holm-adjusted p = .250; we therefore claim no adjusted evidence of a difference. The cleaner domain-specificity contrast, separate learned source scales without their variance penalty versus one shared learned source scale, is -0.13 pp (95% CI [-0.53, 0.27]). Its 90% CI lies within a revision-stage $\pm 1$ pp smallest effect of practical interest (TOST p = .003), supporting equivalence only for the source-selected suite macro, not every dataset, target, or final-step endpoint. The study thus supplies a bounded negative result for this scalar training package; it does not test or refute genuine hyperbolic representation learning.

AI.brief_summary: 该文对一种「曲率启发」的域泛化实现做了受控审计：训练时仅用可学习的正标量重标度欧氏编码器特征，推理时在未缩放特征上接线性分类器，在 PACS、VLCS、Office Home、TerraIncognita 上完成 384 次运行，主要得到一个有界负结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系：工作对象是域泛化的分类精度，且明确说明未实现双曲/流形表示，因此连「表示几何」这一可能线索也不成立，未涉及多模态推理状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，无可供核查的借鉴点。
